---
title: "Rmd 作业相似性证据报告"
runtime: shiny
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    template: null
    mathjax: null
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    anchor_sections: false
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars-tex_math_single_backslash"
params:
  input_a: "examples/report-a.Rmd"
  input_b: "examples/report-b.Rmd"
  exclusion_file: ""
  reference_file: ""
  max_evidence: 10
  text_k: 5
  text_min_chars: 30
  text_min_similarity: 0.8
  formula_min_steps: 2
  formula_max_steps: 5
  formula_max_skips: 1
  code_min_tokens: 20
  code_window_tokens: 100
  code_max_skips: 1
---

``````{r evidence-report, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# rmarkdown removes params after knitting, before Shiny handles user input.
settings <- params
reference_path <- if (nzchar(settings$reference_file)) settings$reference_file else NULL
compare_submissions <- function(input_a, input_b, reference = reference_path) analyze_rmd_pair(
  input_a, input_b,
  text_options = list(k = settings$text_k, min_chars = settings$text_min_chars,
    min_similarity = settings$text_min_similarity),
  formula_options = list(min_steps = settings$formula_min_steps,
    max_steps = settings$formula_max_steps, max_skips = settings$formula_max_skips),
  code_options = list(min_tokens = settings$code_min_tokens,
    window_tokens = settings$code_window_tokens, max_skips = settings$code_max_skips),
  exclusions = if (nzchar(settings$exclusion_file)) settings$exclusion_file else NULL,
  public_reference = reference
)

if (identical(knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.runtime"), "shiny")) {
  uploaded_files <- shiny::reactive({
    files <- list(A = input$assignment_a, B = input$assignment_b, reference = input$public_reference)
    shiny::validate(shiny::need(all(vapply(files[1:2], function(file) NROW(file) == 1L, logical(1))),
      "请选择两份 Rmd 作业。"))
    selected <- Filter(Negate(is.null), files)
    shiny::validate(shiny::need(all(vapply(selected, function(file) grepl("\\.rmd$", file$name,
      ignore.case = TRUE), logical(1))), "所选文件都必须使用 .Rmd 扩展名。"))
    shiny::validate(shiny::need(!nzchar(settings$exclusion_file) ||
      (is.null(files$reference) && is.null(reference_path)), "公共参考文件和 CSV 排除配置请选择其一。"))
    files
  })
  analysis <- shiny::eventReactive(input$analyze, {
    files <- uploaded_files()
    reference <- if (is.null(files$reference)) reference_path else files$reference$datapath
    result <- shiny::withProgress(message = "正在分析两份作业…", value = NULL,
      compare_submissions(files$A$datapath, files$B$datapath, reference))
    result$manifest$filename <- vapply(files[1:2], function(file) file$name, character(1))
    if (!is.null(files$reference) && !is.null(result$exclusions$reference_name)) {
      result$exclusions$reference_name <- files$reference$name
      if (nrow(result$exclusions$records)) result$exclusions$records$reference <- files$reference$name
    }
    list(files = files, html = detector_report_html(result, settings$max_evidence))
  })
  output$analysis_result <- shiny::renderUI({
    shiny::req(input$analyze > 0L)
    files <- uploaded_files()
    completed <- analysis()
    shiny::validate(shiny::need(identical(completed$files, files), "文件已更换，请重新点击「开始分析」。"))
    htmltools::HTML(completed$html)
  })
  shiny::tagList(
    shiny::tags$section(class = "detector-upload", `aria-labelledby` = "upload-title",
      shiny::tags$h2(id = "upload-title", "比较两份作业"),
      shiny::tags$p(class = "muted", "选择两份 UTF-8 编码的 .Rmd 文件。分析在本机完成。"),
      shiny::tags$div(class = "upload-files",
        shiny::tags$div(class = "upload-file", shiny::fileInput("assignment_a", "作业 A",
          accept = ".rmd", buttonLabel = "选择文件", placeholder = "未选择文件")),
        shiny::tags$div(class = "upload-file", shiny::fileInput("assignment_b", "作业 B",
          accept = ".rmd", buttonLabel = "选择文件", placeholder = "未选择文件"))),
      shiny::tags$details(class = "report-details reference-picker",
        shiny::tags$summary("排除共同题干或模板（可选）"),
        shiny::tags$p(class = "muted", "选择老师提供的原始题干或空白模板。报告将排除与参考一致的完整段落、公式和代码块。"),
        shiny::fileInput("public_reference", "题干或模板", accept = ".rmd",
          buttonLabel = "选择参考文件", placeholder = "未选择参考文件")),
      shiny::actionButton("analyze", "开始分析")),
    shiny::tags$div(`aria-live` = "polite", shiny::uiOutput("analysis_result"))
  )
} else {
  report_result <- compare_submissions(settings$input_a, settings$input_b)
  # 明确作为原始 HTML 输出，避免再次按 Markdown 解析
  cat("\n```{=html}\n", detector_report_html(report_result, settings$max_evidence), "\n```\n", sep = "")
}
``````
